intent.raw: Define and design a new full-FOL addition that improves the existing DomainSpec-v2 FormalClaim specification-ontology branch without collapsing TDE, EVF, SMT-provider, proof, or owner boundaries.
intent.objective: Author and deterministically validate a successor Define plus Design candidate in which expressive FOL belongs to FormalClaim meaning, executable and solver projections remain explicitly profiled, and unsupported or indeterminate claims fail closed.

technique_overlays.trigger: The route crosses a frozen owner-gated ontology candidate, FormalClaim semantic ownership, TDE derivation, EVF evidence, and SMT-provider execution while delegating one bounded private candidate authoring task.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: All writes remain inside the declared fresh run outputs; frozen @4, canonical ontology, product, Craft, telemetry, Git, owner-response, admission, migration, execution, and publication bytes remain unchanged; the helper returns one structured receipt.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Repository AGENTS.md requires one native background helper for this non-trivial bounded Invoke authoring and validation route.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One artifact-only helper can author the bounded Define and Design candidate while the parent retains route selection, scope, helper join, user communication, and final claim responsibility.
context: The one-semantic-graph with separately owned branches architecture is already selected.
The frozen @4 package is candidate-valid but all owner responses remain verification-pending.
The new work is a separately staged successor candidate and has no authority effect.
No nested agents, parallel waves, owner admission, implementation, or execution are needed.

roles.purpose: Build strict context, author the successor Invoke Define and six-view Design bundle, run the closed-scope denominator and fixed-point selection, perform the Distill design-unit check, validate the exact run-local artifacts, and return one receipt.
roles.owns: Only the listed fresh run-local context, Define, Design, validation, result, and helper-receipt artifacts

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: invoke define and design this new addition to improve it

steps.name: Build strict Define and Design context

inputs.ref: user-authorized Invoke Define plus Design request and previously selected spec-ontology architecture

stop_conditions: stop if any declared obligation lacks selector-level evidence or explicit resolution
stop if frozen @4 or private authority constraints cannot be preserved

steps.name: Resolve remaining intent ambiguity without reopening settled architecture

capability_metadata.validation_note: The generated alias resolves to the installed canonical interrogation capability.

inputs.ref: user wants full FOL added while preserving the already-started formal-claims ontology branch

stop_conditions: stop instead of inventing a new ontology branch, solver completeness promise, owner acceptance, or exact migration

steps.name: Select exact Invoke templates and source evidence

capability_metadata.validation_note: Use lookup and validate only; do not mutate Inventory.

stop_conditions: stop on an unresolved template tie or blocked Inventory lookup readiness

steps.name: Define the FormalClaim expressive-FOL profile extension
stop_conditions: stop if the candidate edits @4, claims all FOL is decidable, embeds SMT in deterministic derivation, collapses evidence into meaning, or implies authority

steps.name: Author the six-view successor Design candidate
stop_conditions: stop on Work-Pack, SWU, implementation instructions, migration postimages, owner responses, runtime execution, promotion, or publication content

steps.name: Run exact Design denominator and two-pass fixed-point selection
stop_conditions: stop unless scope, source digests, total signal bindings, owner roles, legal dispositions, selected outputs, and fixed point pass

steps.name: Validate the smallest coherent Design unit
stop_conditions: stop if the unit cannot separate expressive claim meaning from executable projection and provider execution without hidden glue

steps.name: Validate exact run-local artifacts and return helper receipt
stop_conditions: stop on out-of-scope writes, stale sources, invalid JSON, path or symlink defects, trailing whitespace, unexecuted-witness inflation, or authority inflation

gates.condition: Every declared Define and Design obligation is covered by exact selector-level evidence or an explicit evidence-backed resolution.
The candidate adds expressive FOL meaning and profile metadata without claiming decidability, solver completeness, proof, admission, or migration.
Manifest, denominator, total concern binding, selected outputs, ownership, and two immutable passes validate.
Frozen @4, exact owner responses, verifier admission, canonical ontology, product, migration, execution, promotion, publication, and release remain unchanged and separately gated.
The helper returns one complete receipt and the parent performs join, independent review, and final claims.

boundaries.contract: Write only the enumerated fresh run-local outputs, preserve parent-authored dispatch and briefing bytes, and return one receipt.

boundaries.to_owner: TDE, EVF, SMT-provider, proof-provider, and promotion lifecycle owners
boundaries.contract: FormalClaim owns exact FOL meaning; downstream components own only declared projections, derivation, verification evidence, provider execution, proof, or promotion and may not reinterpret source meaning.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke Define and Design authoring only
authority.validation: installed Invoke validators plus parent review
authority.promotion: separate exact owner and verifier gates

state_namespaces.write_policy: only enumerated paths in this fresh run; all source, frozen candidate, product, governance, public, telemetry, and Git surfaces remain read-only

promotion_splits.source: Define authored baseline and Design validator pass
promotion_splits.target: owner acceptance, verifier admission, canonical ontology, Plan, implementation, migration, execution, proof, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production
promotion_splits.rule: No transition occurs without separately owned exact-byte acceptance and downstream lifecycle receipts.

observability.signal_grouping: run-local dispatch_id and step_id; no telemetry append authorized

promotion_guardrails: Full FOL source expressiveness does not imply decidability, termination, solver support, validity, proof, or discharge.
TDE consumes only an explicit decidable projection and preserves needs_formal for the remainder.
EVF owns optional verification and witness evidence; SMT providers own pinned runtime execution and may return unsupported, unknown, or timeout without pass.
Frozen @4 owner acceptance cannot be stretched over successor bytes.
Design validators prove only exact source and selection closure.
Planned validators and fixtures are unimplemented and unexecuted Design contracts.
No product, Plan, SWU, Craft, authority, Arcanum, telemetry, Git, migration, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production effect is authorized.
